about_short_description.short_description: Exla is a reusable packaging company that offers custom-made reusable packaging solutions for the protection of delicate components.

product.name: Reusable Packaging
product.description: Exla offers custom-made reusable packaging solutions designed to protect delicate components using materials like metal, plastic, and textile.

product.name: Lean Manufacturing
product.description: Exla provides solutions to streamline processes, reduce time, and improve ergonomics and stock controls in manufacturing operations.

product.name: Customized Solutions
product.description: Exla designs tailored packaging solutions by combining various materials and technologies to meet specific client needs.

product.name: Steel Containers
product.description: Exla manufactures steel containers for logistics solutions, focusing on optimizing customer processes.

product.name: Transport Trolleys
product.description: Exla's transport trolleys facilitate the movement of goods over short distances, enhancing efficiency and storage.

product.name: Plastic Boxes
product.description: Exla produces plastic boxes for internal and external movement of parts, known for their fast manufacturing and durability.
